# `^B0` – Aztec Bar Code

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md)


Print an Aztec two-dimensional matrix barcode with configurable magnification, error correction, and structured append.

Reference parameters: **a, b, c, d, e, f, g**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 64](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
